faqs.a: We are on Turtle Bay Road in Watamu, a short walk from the bay. Parking and a changing room are included, and we shoot on location across the coast on request.

faqs.q: How do I confirm a date?
faqs.a: Choose a session, pick a date and a slot, and pay the 30% deposit. Your reference code arrives immediately and the date is held for you.

faqs.q: When do I get the photographs?
faqs.a: A private online gallery is delivered within seven working days, or within 48 hours with rush delivery. Edited photographs are selected with you before retouching.
Yes, once, free of charge, up to 72 hours before the session. Inside 72 hours the deposit moves to a future date if the studio can fill the slot.
We cover Watamu, Kilifi, Malindi, Mombasa and the outdoor and beach locations shown in the estimator. Travel beyond that is quoted separately after we review your brief.
Bring two or three options in neutral tones and let us see them when you arrive. Hair and make-up, wardrobe styling and an extra backdrop can be added to any session.
